name: sota-ku-rest
procedure: Every question of type knowledge-update, `_abs` ones included, that is in none of the sota-dev, sota-heldout and sota-ku-confirm selections, sorted by ID. With those three it completes the benchmark's 78-question knowledge-update category. Some of these questions were in E1's splits; E1 tuned a different prototype, and nothing in the daemon was tuned on them. Frozen on 2026-11-15 before any run on it.
